candidate_evidence: conservative kernel traffic and arithmetic ceiling, replaced by exact local hybrid measurements once available

goal: maximize Akita Metal-hybrid PIOP throughput while preserving the optimized CPU protocol
goal_prompt: Maximize Akita Metal-hybrid PIOP speedup over optimized CPU at trace sizes 2^26+. Reach at least 4x; 4x is a floor, never a cap. Continue when conservative profiled or analytical headroom predicts another 5% PIOP gain, and always pursue an active kernel when a conservative estimate clearly exceeds 4x. Work one measured bottleneck at a time: derive its ceiling, freeze an exact hybrid evaluator, implement resident/direct-handoff Metal with a CPU cutoff, validate and checkpoint, reprofile the PIOP, then continue. Exclude trace/witness work and PCS commit/opening from the metric; preserve exact proofs and host Fiat-Shamir.

analysis_fanout: portfolio priority and shared primitive reuse
orchestration.candidate_artifact_contract: candidate.json plus analysis.md and candidate.patch, outside the shared worktree; the manifest binds run, base, accepted-parent, all changes outside the editable scope, frozen paths, parent/candidate editable paths, evaluator, analysis, and patch SHA-256 values
orchestration.candidate_reconciliation: root agent freezes one experiment only after reconciling the independent analyses
orchestration.implementation_fanout: after the contract is frozen, subagents may draft non-overlapping shader, host-integration, or evaluator patches as isolated artifacts; the root agent reviews and applies them serially
orchestration.gpu_execution: serialized by the root agent; never overlap GPU evaluators or target-scale CPU controls

promotion_queue.ledger: candidate-events.jsonl records queued, accepted_parent, then production-gated promoted or rejected
promotion_queue.production_gate: five clean interleaved target-scale PIOP pairs with exact proofs and the kernel's local bar
promotion_queue.stale_base_policy: reject before compilation on any manifest or live hash mismatch

orchestration.subagent_mode: read-only analysis by default; isolated patch artifacts only after the experiment freezes; no shared-worktree edits, builds, GPU runs, evaluator mutation, or commits

includes: transcript-dependent kernel preparation and direct handoff
timing_boundary.diagnostic_control: also report PIOP plus transcript-independent backend witness representation materialization
